top_band: greyish-blue top surface from row 1 to row 5, with a bright pink front edge highlight at row 6
evidence: Rows 1-5 form a foreshortened grey-blue horizontal top surface (with a vent/handle detail on top), bounded by a bright pink front-edge line at row 6. Row 7 is a dark purple eave shadow directly beneath the top edge, and rows 8-29 form the vertical purple front face with an inset display window (rows 9-22) and dispenser slot (rows 25-27).

style.evidence: The vending machine is enclosed in a solid 1px near-black outline (#0a0a10) around the entire silhouette and internal window frame, giving it a sticker-like appearance. Main purple body and grey top use only 3 shading steps with ungrained flat fills (e.g., solid purple blocks on the lower panel and right side), lacking the rich multi-step material ramps and surface grain of the Beodeul references.
